data.name: Maisha
data.gender_notes: Maisha is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'ms' which means 'to live'. Maisha is a name that evokes a sense of vitality and energy. The name Maisha carries the meaning “Lively, vivacious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Maisha usually hope their child will grow to embody lively, vivacious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name given to remind the bearer of their connection to the divine, and to encourage them to start anew and live fully
data.etymology: Maisha belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lively, vivacious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Maisha total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: مائشة
in_arabic.long_meaning: مائشة اسم مؤنث مشتق من الفعل 'عيش' الذي يعني الحياة أو الرزق. و تعني حياة الرخاء و السعادة و الرزق الحسن. و قد وردت كلمة 'عيش' في القرآن الكريم في سورة البقرة آية 124: 'وَعَهِدۡتُ إِلَيۡكُمۡ أَنْ أَطۡعَمَكُمۡ وَأَن تَسۡقَوۡنِي'

in_urdu.name: مائشہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: مائشہ ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے خوشحالی اور خوش قسمتی. یہ نام عربی زبان کے الفاظ 'مَيْش' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے 'عیش و عشرت' یا 'خوشی'. جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں میں اس نام کی روایات اور استعمال بہت پرانے ہیں

in_hindi.name: माइशा
in_hindi.long_meaning: माइशा एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है सुखी जीवन और समृद्धि. यह नाम अरबी भाषा के शब्दों से लिया गया है जिनका अर्थ है 'आराम और सुख'. भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में इस नाम का बहुत महत्व है
